response.text: {"title":"Why large beta stalls training","body":"Large beta makes the solution change fast, so the residual is dominated by beta*u_x and is extremely sensitive to small weight changes. That turns the loss landscape steep and badly conditioned, and Adam settles in a poor smooth solution. Krishnapriyan et al. showed that starting at small beta, where the landscape is easy, and raising beta gradually keeps the weights near a good basin.","explanation_index":0,"citation_id":"krishnapriyan2021"}
